title: No startup summary log (data_dir, db_path, owner_id)
description: kithd emits no structured log line at startup recording its effective configuration: data_dir, db_path, owner_id (even partially masked), or which tailscale socket it will use. When diagnosing a production incident months from now, the operator cannot answer 'what data directory was this instance using?' from the logs alone. This is especially sharp when KITH_DB_PATH (legacy) or KITH_OWNER_ID (legacy) are in use, since those vars are accepted silently. Fix: emit one tracing::info\! after config is resolved: 'kithd starting: data_dir={}, db={}, owner={}, ts_socket={}'. Mask owner_id to first/last 4 chars if desired.
